scope.question: Can a lane/link-resolved, mass-conserving packet model recursively update network traffic and the original PP executor without future-state replacement?
scope.state_claim: Closed state of a declared approximate model, not an exact SUMO Markov state or an established deployable controller.
scope.observation_assumption: Fully instrumented current benchmark network. Current positions, speeds and vehicle parameters are causal simulator observations; real-road availability or estimation is a separate requirement.

clock.state_time: S_t is measured after the completed native step ending at t and before requests at t; E_t is the matching executor memory.
clock.input_cutoff: Only observations and events timestamped at or before t may initialize or update an online observation at t.
clock.planning_rollout: After initialization, every subsequent packet, lane sensor value, feasible action, request and applied signal comes from the model and executor; no measured future replacement.

conflicts: physical connection membership for every signal link
static_graph.signal_semantics: For dynamics, preserve complete ordered phase strings and all physical connections sharing each link; G protection and g yielding remain distinct. No any-G lane substitution in the traffic transition model. The unchanged PP scoring rule below still deduplicates its permitted incoming lanes.
static_graph.cost_lanes: The unchanged producer controlled_lane_set; internal lanes remain state even when absent from the original cost set.

cell_index.construction: Geometry-only intervals [15k,min(15(k+1),lane_length)) with the final lane endpoint included in the final interval.
cell_index.role: Fixed adjacency/index and diagnostic aggregation only. Exact packet positions are retained; cells are neither sufficient state nor one-vehicle capacities. A packet may cross multiple cells in one step.
cell_index.capacity: Use actual vehicle lengths/gaps and receiving geometry; do not turn L/7.5 normalization into an asserted physical capacity.

static_graph.identifier_use: Vehicle/lane/TLS/link IDs are joins and graph keys, never ordinal numeric features or cross-city phase-index alignments.

recursive_state.representation: Lane-ordered packets, each with vehicle mass exactly one, plus geometry-only cell indices and complete all-TLS executor memory.

packets.ordering: Order by physical front distance within each lane, retaining both queue-head and following packets.
packets.parameter_updates: Record actual getter values at first observation and when they change; sample allowed speed at each current lane state. Future entrants use past-observed parameter distributions in forecasts, never their future measured profile.
packets.body_trail: Retain the already traversed lane/connection chain until every rear-body segment has cleared it, including current partial occupancy across lane boundaries. Maintain during the native prefix in RAM; a fixed one-second history is insufficient for a stopped straddling vehicle. Missing initial trail remains unresolved rather than being reconstructed from a future route.
packets.movement_belief: Unknown shared-lane destination/turn and future lane changes are persistent latent state inferred only from static legal connections and past observations. A sampled intended connection is retained for the packet, not independently resampled every second. Already occupied internal paths are observed current state.
packets.no_fake_state: An empty lane has no free-flow vehicle or parameter sample. Packet identities, body trail and latent choices survive recursive steps.

lane_sensor_memory.purpose: Initialize the same last-step observables consumed by PP and cost. Future sensor memory must be reconstructed from predicted packets and their one-second traversals, not copied from future SUMO getters.
lane_sensor_memory.native_empty_speed: Preserve the raw getter for audit; use an empty mask rather than interpreting its placeholder as a moving vehicle.

executors.clearance: At each one-second executor update, any predicted vehicle on the specified internal clearance lanes can extend all-red. Current phase identity and pending target are retained, not only clock/mode scalars.

boundary_state.inventory: For every entry, due external demand, waiting-to-insert packets and actually inserted packets are separate quantities. Blocking insertion keeps demand in the external queue.
boundary_state.current_observation: Use only genuinely observed current/up-to-t boundary arrivals and queue information. getPendingVehicles supplies bookkeeping identities but does not by itself establish their entry-lane allocation or complete demand history.
boundary_state.unknown_initial_pending: Record observed global pending count/IDs and unknown entry allocation explicitly. Do not set unobserved entry queues to zero.
boundary_state.forecast: Future due arrivals, entry allocation, initial speed/parameters and turns are forecasts/beliefs based on past data; uncertainty is carried as such. Future route-file schedule is not an online input.
boundary_state.due_event_labels: A sealed demand schedule may label due-at-t demand and pending/inserted accounting after collection. These labels are not automatically available deployment observations.

original_policy_and_cost.phase_pressure: Preserve producer GREEN_CHARS={G,g}: a lane with any such permitted link contributes its q once to the candidate's deduplicated incoming-lane sum. Restrict candidates by the predicted executor feasible set; original candidate order resolves ties. This is the existing PhasePressure rule, not a downstream MaxPressure replacement. This scoring rule does not replace the connection-resolved G/g dynamics.
original_policy_and_cost.recursive_requests: Recompute all-TLS PP requests from predicted observables every 10 seconds, except the declared focal counterfactual request at time zero.
original_policy_and_cost.cost: Each completed one-second step contributes the halted vehicle count on the original controlled_lane_set. C450=sum(H_controlled)/(450*controlled_lane_count). Preserve raw vehicle units and the existing denominator.
original_policy_and_cost.packet_getter_matching: The measurement pilot compares reconstructed N/H/occupancy/mean speed, requests and clearance behavior against the native getters. Keep any reachable body-overlap or last-step mismatch visible; do not repair it by injecting future measurements.

transition_order: At a decision epoch apply requested all-TLS actions to E_t, respecting current phase identity, minimum green and clearance memory.
Read the resulting signal strings for interval [t,t+1). Interpret permissions per physical connection, including yielding, receiving supply and internal inventory.
Advance packets along lane/link geometry with persistent movement beliefs and receiving-space constraints; account explicitly for lateral transfers, entries, exits and terminal removals.
Process forecast due demand through external pending queues and actual insertion; a forecast packet is neither silently dropped nor inserted twice.
Construct S_(t+1) and last-step lane sensor memory from the predicted one-second evolution; advance E using the predicted internal occupancy.
Repeat from S_(t+1),E_(t+1). Measured future requests, signal strings, flows, packets and costs remain labels.

measurement_contract.native_frames: Record full-network preaction t0 and every completed one-second state through the declared horizon, including every internal lane and all active packets.

packet_getters.parameters: Actual vehicle getters already used by record_vehicle_params; never unobserved vType defaults

measurement_contract.executor_trace: Record all-TLS request, acceptance, before/after executor memory at every request epoch, applied signal before every step, and matching executor memory after every completed step.
measurement_contract.flow_labels: Retain per-packet observed lane/cell crossings, physical connection/internal entry and receiving entry, same-road lane changes, due/pending/insertion events and terminal exits. Unobserved skipped internal paths remain unresolved unless uniquely identifiable from past/current observations and static topology.
measurement_contract.population: Keep initial/final active and pending inventories, per-second departed/arrived identities and counted discontinuities. Conservation includes external queues; occupancy is vehicle-body length, not packet mass.
measurement_contract.write_roles: Static graph once; causal observations by timestamp; future measured trajectories/actions/flows/costs in label records. Store large traces on server and return only compact admission results.

forbidden_prediction_inputs: vehicle.getRoute, getRouteIndex, route_ends_here, getNextTLS/getNextLinks, next route edge or actual future destination
future true packet positions/speeds, lane getters, flows, signal strings, PP requests, executor states or costs
future actual departures/insertions, pending queue changes or route-file departure schedule
actual future turn/lane-change outcomes or source/target city/phase IDs used as numeric shortcuts

old_224_reuse.cohort: 64 Hangzhou 10-second branches plus 160 Jinan 450-second branches; original action order, paid labels, splits and HOLD conclusions remain unchanged.
old_224_reuse.causal_initialization: Full physical t0 current vehicle position/speed and actual parameter records, all-network lane endpoint0, full executor snapshots/timings and original repaired net geometry can support causal packet initialization after excluding saved route-derived fields.
old_224_reuse.first_ten_seconds: Observed full-network positions/lane IDs and movement events at t0..t10 are reusable labels. Speeds/parameters were injected only at t0; post-t0 packets are not dense true-speed/parameter records.
old_224_reuse.dense_lane_label_limit: First10-second receiving-lane H/O/speed labels cover 144/192 Hangzhou cost lanes and 102/144 Jinan cost lanes; do not relabel these as complete dense all-lane measurements.
old_224_reuse.later_target_labels: Jinan full-network lane aggregates at 10/30/60/450, all-TLS signals and PP traces, per-second total controlled halting, population ledger and 450-second costs are reusable labels, not recursive observations.
missing_for_rollout_supervision: complete packet speed/lateral state each second
old_224_reuse.nominal_limit: Saved nominal10 sequence is focal-TLS only. All-TLS nominal plans can be constructed from causal initial executor memory and requested actions, but actual clearance extensions depend on traffic predictions.
old_224_reuse.source_costs: No new source450 cost supervision is inferred from the 10-second source branches.

native_occupancy_evidence.fixed_runtime_unit: Native libsumo1.22 fraction of lane length occupied by vehicle bodies; retain raw values and PP coefficient0.025 without conversion.
native_occupancy_evidence.formula_boundary: Body overlap includes partial vehicles. Sum(length of current front-lane IDs)/lane_length is insufficient when a vehicle straddles a boundary; maintain body trail and compare with measured native getter.
native_occupancy_evidence.evidence_source: Existing predecision_server_only.json + physical_start_server_only.json + original repaired net, read on jtl110gpu2 without starting SUMO.
native_occupancy_evidence.documentation_note: Generic TraCI Python documentation says percent; it does not override this fixed native implementation and its recorded measurements.

minimal_measurement_pilot_proposal.seed_tls_anchor: Assigned and frozen by the root protocol before any native start; not selected from pilot cost outcomes.
minimal_measurement_pilot_proposal.purpose: Check dense observation availability, prefix body-trail initialization, native getter semantics, event/population accounting and causal executor update order. This is measurement admission, not an efficacy or transfer experiment.
minimal_measurement_pilot_proposal.hold_if_missing: If required causal initial state or boundary observability is unavailable, report the missing state; do not promote a future-label-conditioned rollout to a deployable model.

implementation_clarification_after_first.body_trail: The causally computed native partial-occupancy accounting trail may be remapped to logical predecessor lanes during an instantaneous lane change. It is not always the sequence of lanes traversed by the front.
implementation_clarification_after_first.observed_lane_path: Keep the unique inferred past front-movement path separately for actual connection/flow labels. Never infer a future route from the remapped occupancy trail.
